subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form.

"Has the file been uploaded by you?"
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Has the file been uploaded by you?"
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "you" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "has been uploaded" to "have you uploaded" (present perfect active).
 
• Ensure the question format remains intact.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Have you uploaded the file?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Did you upload the file?" – Incorrect tense (past simple active).
 
• **Option 2: **"Had you uploaded the file?" – Incorrect tense (past perfect active).
 
• **Option 3: **"Are you uploading the file?" – Incorrect tense (present continuous active).
